text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Spring... Our spring is here. Everything
starts now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is the beginning of our year
together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the Osaka Hai first,
right, Kita?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I hope you don't mind that I'll be
running it
first. And you'll be competing
in the Satsuki Sho
next, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep building ourselves up from
here on out
so we'll be ready for the
Arima Kinen at the end
of the year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! Umatter's buzzing with all
kinds of
rumors!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Can Kitasan Black handle the distance?
The
Osaka Hai's only 2,000 meters.
Compared to the
Kikuka Sho and Arima
Kinen, isn't that too
short?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that this race is shorter than the
ones she
ran at the end of last year,
but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, they were. Now it's the
complete
opposite...
choice_data_list: 『菊花賞』の前は長すぎるって言われたよな
『菊花賞』の前は長すぎるって言われたよね

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I guess people are just going to
talk no
matter how hard I try. There's no
point worrying
about them, is there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We don't have to think about public
opinion
anymore. Kitasan Black's track
record and
confidence is enough to
drown it all out now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Here I go! All I have to do is take
care of
business. I'll conquer all the
races, whether they're
1,000, 2,000, or
3,000 meters long!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Watch me, Dia. Here comes the first
battle!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll start off our journey together with a
bang!
